text:
Love this! For context, I'm working within a company that does behavioral analysis for kids on the spectrum. They're supply constrained because behavior technicians are hard to acquire and even harder to retain. I'm building tools that attack 3 metrics. 

Speed to Onboard - How long after applying does an employee start
90-Day Retention - Of the staff who start, what percentage are still with the company after 90 days
and Overall Retention - How long does the average technician stay with the company in total

I think that becoming the AI Expert in a business is the #1 way that you can have more job security at higher wages and this video literally validated the plan I'm already working on. Thanks, Nate!
author: @DannTheMan

text: Well said
author: @PooSpeaks

text: Those three metrics are unusually well chosen because speed to onboard is the one you can move alone. Ninety day retention has managers and pay inside it, so it moves slowly and someone else gets to argue about the cause. Ship the onboarding one first and let the number be the thing that introduces you.
